description: This file contains the implementation of the AssetRepository class, which provides CRUD operations, queries, and validation checks related to assets and their associated child resources in a database. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, soft-deleting assets, and managing related entities like asset status logs, additional asset IDs, properties, control device mappings, input parameters, and their dependents.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class encapsulating database operations for assets, status logs, supplementary IDs, properties, control mappings, input parameters, and related entities, with methods for CRUD, validation, and complex queries.

classes.name: AssetRepository.EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a requested asset entity is not found during validation processes.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database and returns its DTO.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by its ID, excluding soft-deleted records.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset record and returns the updated DTO.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Fetches a filtered list of assets based on provided criteria.

methods.name: PermitEuIdExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks whether a non-deleted asset with the specified Permit EU ID exists, optionally excluding a specific asset ID.

methods.name: AssetExistsAsync
methods.description: Verifies if an asset exists and is not soft-deleted.

methods.name: SoftDeleteAssetGraphAsync
methods.description: Soft deletes an asset and its dependent records in other related tables within a transaction.

methods.name: InputParameterBelongsToAssetAsync
methods.description: Confirms whether a specific input parameter belongs to an asset and is not deleted.

methods.name: ThroughputEquationBelongsToInputAsync
methods.description: Checks if a throughput equation belongs to a specified input parameter.

methods.name: WouldParentInputMappingCreateCycleAsync
methods.description: Determines if creating a parent-child mapping between input parameters would introduce a cycle.

methods.name: ReportingAttributeCombinationExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks for duplicate reporting attribute mappings within an asset.

methods.name: GetLatestStatusToDateAsync
methods.description: Fetches the most recent status date for an asset from the status log.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status log entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all status log entries for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a specific status log entry for an asset by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific asset status log record.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates a new additional asset ID record.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional IDs associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional asset ID by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID record.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset property record.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset property by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset property record.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a new control device mapping for an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists all control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control device mapping by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping record.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates a new input parameter linked to an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists all input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific input parameter by ID.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter record.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a given child input parameter ID.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a specified child input parameter ID.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping under a child input parameter scope.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a reporting attribute mapping under an asset scope.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping under an asset scope.

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF source mapping under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings under an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an EF source mapping under an input parameter scope.

methods.name: CreateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput equation under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations under an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation under an input parameter scope.

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar under a throughput equation.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput scalars under a throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar under a throughput equation scope.

methods.name: CreateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Creates a data input value under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync
methods.description: Lists data input values under an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value under an input parameter scope.
